text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The next day, Seiun Sky doesn't show up for morning training. It seems she hasn't even come to school…

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: That's why I've been using my head to win. Pretty obvious, huh?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: If that's what you call thinking up waaay too many scenarios and how you'd deal with them…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm positive she's still trying to get better, so I have to figure out something that can help her!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Later that night, it's peaceful and quiet…

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: You're late. I thought you'd get here sooner.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Not a single one. All I've pulled up is seaweed.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The sound of gently breaking waves interrupts the silence. Without a word, I cast my line beside hers, and she begins to open up little by little.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: …Obviously, I wasn't being serious back there. I'm not tired of racing.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: I was just thinking… how am I supposed to overcome all these obstacles and limitations I have?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: How am I supposed to beat other Umamusume who just keep getting better and better, when I'm already at my peak?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: So I thought that if I went fishing… a good strategy might come to mind.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Back there… I wasn't for real, you know?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Hah. So you saw right through me.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: …I think King did too, at least a little. She's just impatient.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: But… I really am stuck.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Geez, fishing was pointless. I can't come up with anything. I'm just staring at the water!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: I'm through, I surrender, I'm waving the white flag! …Not really.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: I'm just… so played out.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: That's so played out.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I remember when she said that before. Those words were directed at herself—not at me or anyone else.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Maybe it was high tide for me already. My time's over and done with, so I should throw in the towel!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: It's miraculous enough that someone as weak as me could get this far.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: I even ran in the Classics like Gramps always wanted.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: I should pat myself on the back and say, "Nice job, kiddo!"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Yeah… Right? I've already had a good enough career!
choice_data_list: Right. You're one of the greats.
Right. You're one of the greats.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: But… I can't forget it.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: That moment when everyone's perception of me changed.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: The surprise, the commotion! The cheers and screams! That moment the world turned upside down!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: I wanna feel that excitement one more time!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Even though I'll never snag another bite, I can't forget that moment. So I keep casting my line.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: She asked if I don't want to win anymore…

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Of course I still wanna win, duh. That's why I've been running all this time.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: But, you know… I don't know anymore.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: It's like there's a wall in front of me, with a sign on it saying, "This is as far as you go."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Up until now, I've been digging under or clambering over the walls.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: But it's clear there's no way for me to get past this one. I'm afraid to even run toward it.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Yeah… I'm scared. I don't wanna know that it's over for me…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She turns her head down, but I catch a glimpse of tears welling up in her eyes.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Even though she always acted carefree, like nothing ever affected her, she's always been battling this uncertainty…

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Nah… There's nothing for you to apologize for.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: I'm the only one who can do anything about this…

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: In the end, the only person you can rely on… is yourself.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: That's just what she said once before. Sure, it's true that her own strength is what will carry her forward, but…

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Urgh! I can't even catch a damn fish…

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Sigh… Like, really! I'm such a loser right now.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Yup… And no matter how many times I cast my line, I don't get a thing.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Huh? What do you—why are you walking into the water? W-wait a sec!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Splash!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Whoa! Trainer, are you okay?!
choice_data_list: I'm going to herd the fish to you! Get the net!
I'm going to herd the fish to you Get the net!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: H-huh, w-wait, wha? Uh… okay?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I chase the fish toward where Sky is waiting, and then…

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: …Got a small fry.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: I mean… does this really count as a catch? I didn't even use my rod.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Hold on a sec… Sorry, my thoughts are all over the place.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: What… was that just now?
choice_data_list: If you can be brave even when you're scared, you can make a change!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Oh! So you dove into the sea to show me that? Right… because…

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Pfft… Ahaha! I don't understand you at all!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Haha, that's so not like you! Oh boy, you really shocked me.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Like… you don't have to go to such extremes if you just want to give me courage.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: How is what you did going to make this wall I'm facing disappear?
choice_data_list: You haven't even tried knocking it down yet.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
choice_data_list: Be brave. I want you to knock it down.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: But what if it doesn't work? What if this just becomes a painful memory?
choice_data_list: As powerful as you are now, you can definitely break it down.
As powerful as you are now, you can definitely break it down.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I hand her the materials I'd been compiling since this morning.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: This is… my training record up until now? All the races I ran up to the Takarazuka Kinen are in here…

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Hah. You even wrote down all the times I skipped? I definitely am a pain in your neck, huh?
choice_data_list: You still have plenty of surprises in you.
You still have plenty of surprises in you.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: I'll start training again. But as for racing… I can't promise anything.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: I might get scared and run away… You okay with that?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: …Can you let me be alone for a while? I promise I'll be back before curfew.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm sure that Sky will grasp something from this. Confident that she'll return to racing, I leave her to her thoughts.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Psh… You believe in me, huh?
